description: Signed agent-command envelopes (docs/design/agent-principals.md §4.3). Each envelope is verified with hostSign at `now` (a case may carry its own). A case with refusedBy is refused with that code; one without verifies.

valid.name: valid reply that follows an earlier message
valid third message of A to B to A, sender is the first via entry

refused.name: body with whitespace is not canonical
first message whose root is not its request
body base64 with non-zero trailing bits
session.get with a target instance and no session
hostSign point that is not on the curve
envelope issued more than 120 seconds in the future
via that leaves out the sender
prev with the root as the request
first message with a prev missing but two messages
window with a character outside the set
origin category with a capital first letter
origin account that is not an id
session with a character outside the set
